item.title: Pershing's Ackman sees a $1 trillion Israeli company within a decade
item.description: Billionaire investor Bill Ackman said he remained bullish on Israel’s economy and financial markets, predicting the country could produce a $1 trillion company within a decade. He highlighted Israel’s technology ecosystem, AI potential and growing ambitions to build global companies, while saying the country’s small population could become an advantage.

item.title: Average long-term US mortgage rate eases to 7.32% in first pullback since late August
item.description: US mortgage rates eased for the first time since late August, with the average 30-year fixed rate falling to 7.32% from 7.40% last week, Freddie Mac said. The decline offers some relief to homebuyers, but borrowing costs remain elevated, with higher rates continuing to weigh on US home sales and demand.

item.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
item.description: Indian equities fell sharply as rising crude prices, rupee weakness and global uncertainties pressured sentiment. Sensex lost over 460 points, Nifty declined 124 points, and BSE-listed companies lost Rs 3 lakh crore in market value.

item.title: Yes Bank unlikely to pay AT1 bond coupons despite bond holders demand, sources say
item.description: Yes Bank has announced potential non-payment of coupons on additional tier-1 bonds this fiscal year following a Supreme Court decision that annulled the previous write-off of these bonds. Bondholders are advocating for repayment based on the court's ruling, which emphasizes unsettled dues. Nonetheless, Yes Bank maintains it has ultimate authority over coupon payments, raising concerns about its financial losses impacting these obligations.

item.title: Sebi warns investors against WhatsApp stock tips. Here's how you can avoid such traps
item.description: SEBI has cautioned investors against exclusive WhatsApp groups spreading unauthorised stock tips and fake profit claims. The regulator flagged astroturfing, overseas numbers, replacement groups and suspicious trading apps, urging investors to verify credentials and use registered intermediaries.

item.title: Anthropic IPO stands alone as AI market jitters sideline others
item.description: Anthropic plans to move forward with its initial public offering next month, navigating a challenging IPO landscape. While many companies in the AI field have delayed their public listings due to fluctuating interest rates and significant market instabilities, investors still see potential in Anthropic as a leading tech contender. Concerns are arising from the recent Oura IPO regarding institutional investor interest, emphasizing the heightened scrutiny on AI investment strategies.

item.title: NCDEX launches NDEX and FINNDEX to expand into equity benchmarks
item.description: NCDEX has launched NDEX and FINNDEX, two equity benchmarks tracking 20 large, liquid Indian stocks and 15 financial sector companies. Their multi-factor methodology incorporates market capitalisation, trading activity, beta and volatility, with semiannual rebalancing.

item.title: CreditAccess Grameen Q2 profit jumps fourfold to Rs 502 crore
item.description: CreditAccess Grameen reported a fourfold rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 502 crore, driven by higher income, lower expenses and credit costs. Improved asset quality prompted upward revisions to profitability guidance, while assets under management grew 19.5%.

item.title: Tesla shares slip as capex cut clouds Musk’s AI, robotics ambitions
item.description: Tesla's shares dipped by 2% after it reduced its capital spending forecast for 2026, now predicting $20 billion instead of the previous $25 billion. This move has raised eyebrows among investors, especially with Tesla's stock already down 14% this year. Yet, it still boasts a higher valuation than many traditional automakers. Meanwhile, potential merger talks with SpaceX hint at regulatory hurdles that might prolong uncertainty for investors.

item.title: Kolkata home registrations dip 12 per cent in Jan-Sep; larger flats gain share
item.description: In the first three quarters of 2026, home registrations in the Kolkata Metropolitan Area fell to 41,309, highlighting a year-on-year decline. Yet, there was an observable trend towards mid-sized and larger apartments. Specifically, September recorded 4,845 registrations, down from the previous year, with North Kolkata dominating 36% of the total shares. This data reveals a growing preference for spacious and practical living spaces among buyers.

item.title: Hatsun Agro Product Q2 Results: Profit rises 5.6% on strong sales
item.description: Hatsun Agro Product reported a notable growth in net profit for the September quarter, reaching Rs 115.69 crore, up from Rs 109.54 crore from last year. Total income also surged to Rs 2,902.49 crore, showcasing strong sales amidst industry hurdles. The company emphasizes enhancing direct consumer relationships and expanding its market footprint in Maharashtra and Odisha, while continuing to invest in its procurement, processing, and distribution systems.

item.title: US stocks today: US stocks slide as AI spending jitters hit Nasdaq, oil prices rebound
item.description: US stocks opened lower on Thursday as renewed concerns over the outlook for artificial intelligence weighed on growth stocks. Tesla and Meta earnings failed to ease AI-related jitters, while rising oil prices added to market pressure. The Nasdaq fell 1.48%, while the S&P 500 and Dow also declined at the open.

item.title: Record galore! Jio IPO claims crown for highest QIB demand among India’s 5 largest issues, edges past NSE
item.description: Jio Platforms’ Rs 30,213-crore IPO attracted 12.87 times QIB subscription, surpassing NSE’s institutional demand. Overall subscription reached 5.36 times by Day 2, with a strong grey market premium and positive brokerage recommendations.

item.title: US stocks 2026: Moderna, SanDisk lead top 10 gainers delivering up to 734% returns
item.description: Ten US stocks with market caps above $5 billion have seen share prices more than triple in 2026, delivering returns up to 734%. Healthcare and tech sectors dominate, led by biotechnology firm Moderna and flash memory maker SanDisk, highlighting strong momentum across biotech and established tech majors like Dell.

item.title: SoFi targets idle crypto cash with interest-bearing tokenized deposit
item.description: SoFi Technologies has launched an innovative tokenized deposit product that offers an attractive 4.2% annual interest rate. Funds deposited are insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation for amounts up to $250,000 per depositor. This strategic move enables customers to prepare for crypto acquisitions while still earning interest, rather than letting cash sit idle.

item.title: Colgate-Palmolive India Q2 Results: Profit rises 4.3% to Rs 341.6 crore
item.description: Colgate-Palmolive India Ltd has reported a 4.3% increase in net profit for the September quarter. The company achieved a net profit of Rs 341.57 crore compared to Rs 327.51 crore last year. Sales increased by 12.22% to Rs 1,691.57 crore in this quarter. The gross margin expanded by 40 basis points year-on-year, reflecting cost management strategies and pricing actions.

item.title: Sebi allows margin relief against early pay-in of securities for subsequent trades
item.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) has announced a new directive that eases margin requirements for clients with a net sell obligation. This policy is particularly applicable when early pay-in requests are accepted by the clearing corporation, allowing clients to execute trades more efficiently. No margin will be collected on future trades up to the value of accepted early pay-in securities.

item.title: Meta falls as investors balance Muse growth with rising AI costs
item.description: Shares of Meta Platforms fell about 3% in premarket trading on Thursday, as investors weighed the benefits of the company's fast-growing AI agent business against the mounting costs of funding its ambitious AI expansion.

item.title: Union Pacific's third-quarter profit rises on pricing strength
item.description: Union Pacific showcased impressive third-quarter adjusted profit, primarily fueled by increased fuel surcharge revenue and solid core pricing strategies. The boost in operating revenue reflects their commitment to maintaining pricing discipline and enhancing operational efficiencies. Despite the hurdles posed by geopolitical-driven energy price hikes, US railroads have effectively sustained profitability, benefiting from improved service reliability that attracted new freight volumes while keeping existing customers engaged.

item.title: HPCL Q2 Results: Profit slips 6% YoY to Rs 3,625 crore, revenue jumps 26%
item.description: HPCL reported Q2FY27 net profit of Rs 3,625 crore, recovering from a previous-quarter loss. Revenue rose 26.1% year-on-year, refining margins surged, fuel sales increased, and investments advanced infrastructure expansion, innovation, and green energy initiatives.

item.title: Mahindra Lifespace Q2 profit down 66 pc to Rs 16 cr
item.description: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Ltd experienced a substantial 66 percent drop in consolidated net profit for the quarter ending September 2026, with profits falling to Rs 16.34 crore compared to Rs 47.91 crore last year. However, total income saw remarkable growth, reaching Rs 104.02 crore, up from Rs 33.06 crore. For the first half of this fiscal year, net profit saw a minor uptick to Rs 101.

item.title: Indian bonds tumble on oil surge, RBI rate hike fears
item.description: Indian government bonds experienced a decline as the benchmark yield exceeded 7.45% on Thursday. Oil prices rose significantly, reaching $112.50 per barrel in Asian trading amid geopolitical tensions. The Reserve Bank of India has raised its repo rate to 5.50%, indicating a potential for further hikes. Inflation concerns are mounting, with expectations for retail inflation to surpass the central bank's tolerance limit.

item.title: India's JSW Paints eyes 4, 5-year debt to refinance acquisition-led funding, bankers say
item.description: India's JSW Paints is likely to raise funds through issuance of bonds maturing in four years and five years and should go ahead with the sale in the next couple of weeks, two merchant bankers with direct knowledge of the matter said on Thursday.

item.title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today |Live Updates: Nasdaq crashes 2% as AI, oil risks drive flight to bonds
Market wrap: Bajaj Finance, Cipla, Nestle India, Eternal top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Thursday
item.description: Indian equity markets fell for a third consecutive session as weak global cues and sustained selling weighed on sentiment. The Nifty 50 declined 0.54% to 22,688, while the Sensex dropped 0.62% to 73,249.

item.title: Global Market: Japanese banks see rising corporate loan demand ahead of BOJ meeting
item.description: Japanese banks report rising corporate funding demand despite the Bank of Japan’s 1.25% interest rate, reinforcing expectations of further monetary tightening. Persistent inflation risks, resilient lending and government concerns will shape the central bank’s upcoming policy decision.

item.title: UBS acquires 4.8% stake in wealth manager 360 ONE WAM through warrant exercise
item.description: UBS has acquired a 4.8% stake in 360 ONE WAM by exercising 2.05 crore warrants and paying around Rs 1,584 crore. The transaction follows a partnership announced in April 2025, under which UBS agreed to sell its Indian onshore wealth management business to the Mumbai-based firm for about $32 million.

item.title: Global Market: Why China could complicate Musk’s Tesla-SpaceX merger plans
item.description: Elon Musk’s proposed Tesla–SpaceX merger faces potential regulatory hurdles in the US and China over national security, sensitive data and technology sharing. Tesla’s dependence on Chinese manufacturing and revenue complicates efforts to integrate SpaceX’s defence operations.

item.title: Adani Total Gas Q2 Results: Net profit rises 6% YoY to Rs 173 crore, revenue jumps 34%
item.description: Adani Total Gas Q2 Results: Adani Total Gas reported a 5.9% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 173.27 crore, while revenue from operations climbed 33.8% to Rs 2,109.65 crore. EBITDA grew 12% YoY, supported by higher CNG and PNG volumes and continued expansion of its city gas distribution network.

item.title: Global Market: China's Lingjun Investment attracts $300 million from overseas investors
item.description: China’s Lingjun Investment has raised at least $300 million from US and Southeast Asian investors as it resumes overseas fundraising. Strong fund returns and AI-driven interest support growth, while regulatory scrutiny makes governance and risk management critical.

item.title: Tata Motors CV Q2 Results Preview: Profit may rise up to 44% YoY, revenue 45%; margins, volume growth in focus
item.description: Tata Motors Commercial Vehicles is expected to post strong Q2FY27 revenue and profit growth, driven by 43% volume expansion. However, rising input costs, margin pressures and divergent brokerage estimates remain key investor concerns ahead of results and management commentary.

item.title: Jammu & Kashmir Bank Q2 Results: Net profit rises over 10% YoY to Rs 546 crore, NII jumps 5%
item.description: Jammu & Kashmir Bank reported a 10.6% year-on-year rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 546.4 crore. Operating profit increased 26.7%, while asset quality improved, with gross NPA falling to 2.23%. Advances grew 23.7% to Rs 1.34 lakh crore, and deposits rose 16.3% to Rs 1.77 lakh crore.

item.title: Swiggy Q2 Results: Loss narrows YoY to Rs 922 crore; revenue jumps 36%
item.description: Swiggy Q2 Result: Food delivery and quick commerce company Swiggy Ltd on Thursday said its consolidated profit after tax narrowed to Rs 922 crore in the second quarter of FY27 from Rs 1,092 crore in the same quarter of last year. However, on a sequential basis, losses increased from Rs 792 crore posted in the preceding June quarter.

item.title: 10 stocks plunge up to 53% from their yearly peaks
item.description: India’s market correction has pushed several midcap stocks sharply below their 52-week highs. Ten stocks, including Rail Vikas Nigam, PB Fintech and Swiggy, have fallen between 40% and 53%, underperforming broader indices amid heightened volatility and sustained selling pressure.

item.title: Rupee snaps eight-day rally as oil climbs to highest since May
item.description: The Indian rupee ended its eight-session-long winning streak, closing down 0.4% at 94.8175 per dollar. Concerns over escalating oil prices amid the Middle East conflict contributed to global market volatility. Brent oil prices reached $112.40 per barrel, impacting India's economy due to high crude imports. The Reserve Bank of India faced pressure on whether to defend the currency amid these pressures.

item.title: Barclays Q3 profit rises 12% YoY, lender announces £500 million share buyback
item.description: Barclays reports a 12% rise in third-quarter pretax profit to £2.3 billion, broadly meeting expectations, and announces a £500 million share buyback. Strong equities trading and stable costs offset weaker fixed-income revenue, as investors assess the outlook for UK bank taxation.

item.title: Adani Energy Q2 Results: Profit zooms 148% YoY to Rs 1,323 crore; revenue jumps 53%
item.description: Adani Energy Q2 Results: Revenue from operations in the reporting period rose 53% YoY to Rs 10,076 crore.

item.title: Jio leverage play pops up at SBI as India brokers lure IPO bets
item.description: SBI Securities has launched an exciting financing option for the highly anticipated IPO of Jio Platforms Ltd. Investors can secure up to 60% funding for their subscriptions, with the IPO set to open for bids on October 21. The impressive demand already seen indicates a surge in interest, prompting several brokerages to engage new clients. This event could usher in a wave of new investors into the market.

item.title: RIL stock: Jio's listing could unlock value, but will it drive a re-rating?
item.description: The anticipated IPO of Jio Platforms is likely to reshape valuation assessments for both Reliance Industries and Bharti Airtel. With Jio's market debut, Reliance may witness a decrease in its holding-company discount. Meanwhile, Airtel stands to gain from rising telecom tariffs, boosting average revenue per user and overall profitability. The enthusiasm from investors towards Jio's IPO highlights strong market confidence in the sector's trajectory.

item.title: Amagi Media Labs shares fall 3% after company flags cyber extortion attempt
item.description: Amagi Media Labs shares dropped on Thursday after the company disclosed a cyber extortion attempt involving allegedly obtained operational and network configuration data. The company is investigating the claim with external cybersecurity experts and legal counsel, while stating that services remain unaffected and no material financial impact is expected at this stage.

item.title: Michael Burry bets against these 4 AI stocks, one of which rallied 190% YTD. Will his AI bubble warnings come true?
item.description: Michael Burry is betting against Nvidia, Palantir, Tesla and Micron amid concerns over AI valuations, chip depreciation and memory supply cycles. His warnings about a potential AI bubble have intensified as investors weigh surging stock prices against heavy AI spending and future revenue prospects.

item.title: Global Market: Japanese investors extend foreign bond selling streak to five weeks
item.description: Japanese investors extended their foreign bond selling streak to five weeks through October 17, offloading 161.6 billion yen of long-term debt as US Treasury yields retreated from 24-year highs. Year-to-date net disposals reached 5.18 trillion yen, the highest for the comparable period since 2022, while overseas equity buying continued.

item.title: D-Street's margin-funded stock bets fall as smallcap rally falters
item.description: Retail traders in India are reducing their leveraged bets on stocks as the market showcases a decline. Recently, borrowed positions dropped to 1.56 trillion rupees after a record high in September. The NSE 500 Index has decreased almost 9% from its peak, pushing small- and mid-caps down significantly. Furthermore, higher interest rates and persistent oil prices have added pressure to the equity market.

item.title: Stock crash alert! eMudhra shares plunge 37% in just two sessions. What’s unfolding?
item.description: eMudhra shares plunged 37% in two sessions after a critical security incident involving compromised private keys linked to eight intermediate Certificate Authority certificates. MeitY said its Indian digital signature and eSign services remain unaffected. The affected global TLS business contributes around 1% of revenue, but reputational risks remain.

item.title: Meta Q3 Earnings: AI spending, revenue beat & new stock class
item.description: Meta Platforms beat third-quarter revenue estimates as advertising growth lifted sales 26% to $64.6 billion. However, rising capital expenditure on artificial intelligence, negative free cash flow and a new non-voting share class put the spotlight on investment returns and shareholder implications.

item.title: Never a dull moment! Why Jefferies raised Eternal’s target price after Q2 earnings
item.description: Jefferies raised its target price on Eternal to Rs 430 from Rs 415, implying around 38% upside from its previous close of Rs 312.35. The brokerage cited Blinkit’s faster store expansion and improving unit economics, food delivery growth of over 20%, and rising confidence in District.

item.title: NCDEX launches NDEX and FINNDEX indices to foray into equity and derivatives markets
item.description: NCDEX has launched NDEX and FINNDEX, two rule-based indices covering large and liquid Indian equities and financial sector stocks. The benchmarks use a multi-factor methodology incorporating market capitalisation, liquidity, beta and volatility, with semi-annual rebalancing.

item.title: Ashish Kacholia portfolio: Ace investor adds 3 new stocks, trims stake in 13 companies in Q2
item.description: Ace investor Ashish Kacholia reshuffled his Rs 3,000 crore portfolio in Q2FY27, adding three stocks, increasing stakes in two companies and trimming holdings in 13 others. The changes include new bets on ESDS Software Solutions, Ardee Industries and Credent Connect N Care, while Fineotex Chemicals and Brand Concepts may have been exited.

item.title: Global Market: China's yuan hits more than four-year high against dollar
item.description: In a remarkable turn of events, China's yuan has surged against the US dollar, hitting levels unseen in over four years. This strength is linked to a declining dollar and prevailing central bank strategies. Although the People's Bank of China set a midpoint lower than anticipated, its actions aim to moderate currency appreciation. Analysts believe the yuan's resilience may hinge on sustained export performance and domestic demand influences.

item.title: Adani Green Energy shares fall 4% after Q2 results. What are Jefferies, JM Financial saying?
item.description: Adani Green Energy reported a 15% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 673 crore, while revenue grew 39% to Rs 4,520 crore. Shares fell 4% after the results. Jefferies maintained its Buy rating, while JM Financial retained Add, citing growth opportunities and operational challenges.
